Method of Attack: Trojaned extension that asks for elevated permissions to read and change all data on visited websites
Monitors login form submissions to Amazon, Microsoft, Github, Google
Monitors form submissions with variables named username, email, user, login, usr, pass, passwd, password
Exfiltrates credentials and variable values to a server in Ukraine (https://www.megaopac.host/)
Executes JavaScript to steal cryptocurrency private keys from myetherwallet.com, mymonero.com, idex.market
Impacted Systems: Google Chrome browser with MEGA extension installed
Websites: amazon.com, live.com, github.com, google.com, myetherwallet.com, mymonero.com, idex.market
Attack Vector: Compromised Chrome Web Store account used to upload trojaned extension
Extension installation or autoupdate with elevated permissions
Indicators of Compromise: Extension asks for permissions to read and change all data on websites visited
